modules.module_title: Planning and supervision of equipment operations

pcs.pc_description: plan and schedule equipment operations in accordance with organization, Safety Health Environment, worksite guidelines and procedures
plan and match equipment and resources required as per the task
select the equipment according to the requirement of the project
allocate the schedule of operators and other P&M support personnel as per the project requirements
appropriately allocate work to subordinate team-mates as per their experience/ skill levels
train and elaborate them on the assigned jobs
communicate job expectations, based on task and site conditions, clearly to the team- mates
monitor and supervise operations on an ongoing basis to meet project requirements
carry out appraisals and training of the team-mates at regular intervals
adhere to organization and worksite level policies / procedures
adhere to relevant quality processes / standards during operations
complete role related documentation and reporting
resolve process level issues or queries based on interactions with other stakeholders and managers

pcs.pc_description: comply with all organizational guidelines, SHE policy and quality standards during equipment operations
supervise the enforcement of all HSE related guidelines in equipment operations
plan procurement and provide safety gear and other equipment required to personnel for safe and productive operations
carry out fire/ other disaster recovery drills on work site along with the HSE team
inspect fire extinguishers and other machine equipment for validity and plan procurement/ renewal for necessary equipment

assist with checking the project management plan to ensure operations are as per the quality and productivity specifications outlined
carry out routine random checks and inspections to keep a check on the quality of work carried out
inspect damage to equipment and suggest rectification as per the work protocol and quality standards
give feedback to team and stakeholders on the quality and productivity at the worksite on the continuous basis
carry out role related documentation and reporting

use personal protective equipment (ppe) and other safety gear as applicable to the equipment and the worksite
Follow safety measures during operations to ensure that the health and safety of self or others (including members of the public) is not at risk
Carry out operations as per the manufacturer's and worksite related health and safety guidelines
Handle the transport, storage and disposal of hazardous materials and waste in compliance with worksite health, safety and environmental guidelines
operate various grades of fire extinguishers, as applicable
support in administering basic first aid and report to concerned team members, as required, in case of an accident
respond promptly and appropriately to an accident/ incident or emergency, within limits of your role and responsibility
record and report details related to operations, incidents or accidents, as applicable
